name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: Text with a hatched, diagonal-lined shadow that slowly slides behind it. The hatching holds still under reduced motion.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. The shadow is a decorative copy, so screen readers read it once.

props.name: shadowColor
props.description: Color of the hatched shadow. Any CSS color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the hatching takes to slide by one stripe. 0 holds it still.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and holds the hatching still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
